maintenance_led.reason: Supplies aftermarket automotive replacement parts, fasteners and brake/chassis components for repair of vehicles already on the road.

publicly_funded.reason: Sells to auto parts retailers, distributors and repair shops serving private vehicle owners; not government-funded.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through new product development and sales; acquisitions like SuperATV and Super ATV are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Aftermarket parts are sold to retailers who can source alternatives from competing suppliers; switching is relatively easy.
